comment: The solar wind speed has trended back toward background levels as the influence of a coronal hole waned over the weekend. Solar activity has been low, and there have been no Earth-directed coronal mass ejections. High-speed solar wind from a centrally located coronal hole is expected to begin to arrive towards the end of the third forecast period. This could bring ACTIVE to STORM G1 periods from late on the 26th or into the 27th August.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
